notes: PARTIAL approved runtime rule pack: only the Honeywell MVP Batch 2 term/support/software configuration-expansion decisions are active. Batch 1 is a SEPARATE approved pack (honeywell-batch1-approved-rules) and is unchanged by this pack. The full 53-child-line Honeywell candidate pack is NOT approved. Batch 3 replacement candidates and Batch 4 broader Cisco generalization remain deferred and out of scope. 3Y (36-month) is the approved default term for Batch 2; 5Y/7Y (60/84-month) remain engineer-review alternatives only and no 5Y/7Y SKU name is invented or included. No pricing authority is encoded here; what to add/default/offer is configuration authority, while pricing is resolved separately from the catalog/price source at runtime, so the two stay strictly separate. The source candidate packs (honeywell-candidate-rules.json, honeywell-candidate-rules-v2.json) and the review/approval packets (honeywell-rule-approval-packet.json, honeywell-rule-approval-packet-v2.json, honeywell-batch2-approval-packet.json) remain unchanged and candidate/pending; this approved pack is a new, separate artifact.
